Predicates:
Lead(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Formed(x, y) ::: x is formed in y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
Formed(diamondMine, wwe) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, formed in WWE.
Lead(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers.
Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes Ivy Nile.
Feud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
Lead(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick strong leads a professional wrestling stable.
